about: Patrick A. Salvi II is the Managing Equity Partner of Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard and has served as Managing Partner of the firm’s Chicago office since 2017. He is widely recognized as one of the state’s most accomplished trial attorneys. Since joining the firm in 2007, Mr. Salvi has recovered more than $2 billion for individuals and families affected by catastrophic injuries, medical negligence, wrongful death, mass torts, and product liability, secured through some of the largest plaintiff jury verdicts in Illinois history.

Mr. Salvi has served as lead counsel in some of the most significant and closely watched cases in the state. In 2022, he was the lead attorney on a trial team that won a $363 million jury verdict for a woman who developed breast cancer after exposure to toxic emissions from a medical sterilization plant in Willowbrook, Illinois—at the time, the largest jury verdict ever awarded to an individual plaintiff in Illinois history. As co-lead counsel in the litigation, Mr. Salvi later served as lead negotiator for global settlements totaling $456 million for nearly 900 additional plaintiffs. In 2026, Mr. Salvi again led a trial team to win a $241 million jury verdict for the family of a Missouri man who died while transporting dry ice as part of his work as a courier, including $49.5 million in compensatory damages and $191.5 million in punitive damages. His other landmark results include a $148 million jury verdict for a young dancer paralyzed when a pedestrian shelter collapsed on her at O’Hare International Airport—the highest compensatory verdict ever awarded to an individual plaintiff in Illinois—and a $79.85 million verdict for the family of a 10-year-old girl killed in a crash stemming from an unauthorized Chicago Police Department pursuit. Additional noteworthy results include a $75.85 million jury verdict for a child who suffered severe birth injuries, a $52 million jury verdict for the family of a father killed in a multi-vehicle crash, a $210.25 million wrongful death settlement, and a $60.7 million wrongful death settlement.

Mr. Salvi’s accomplishments have earned him recognition among the nation's premier trial lawyers. In 2024, he was invited to join the Inner Circle of Advocates, an invitation-only organization limited to 100 trial lawyers nationwide. In 2025, he was selected for inclusion in Lawdragon Legends, a guide honoring only 28 esteemed attorneys nationwide. He has been named Best Lawyers “Lawyer of the Year” in Chicago for Personal Injury Law and Medical Malpractice Law in 2022, 2024, 2025, 2026, and 2027. In 2023, Mr. Salvi was named “Person of the Year” by Chicago Lawyer Magazine, recognizing his work on the Sterigenics litigation and his efforts as President of the Illinois Trial Lawyers Association (ITLA) in amending the wrongful death statute to include punitive damages. In 2025, he received the “Plaintiff Attorney Achievement Award” from the Jury Verdict Reporter and Law Bulletin Media. He has also received the Trial Lawyer Excellence Award five times, the American Association for Justice’s (AAJ) “Above and Beyond Award” twice, the AAJ’s “Wiedemann and Wysocki Award,” and the AAJ’s F. Scott Baldwin Award.

Beyond his trial work, Mr. Salvi served as President of the Illinois Trial Lawyers Association from 2022 to 2023 and remains active as co-chair of its Publications Committee and co-author of the Medical Malpractice Trial Notebook chapter on Informed Consent. He sits on the AAJ Board of Governors, the AAJ PAC Board of Trustees, and served on the 2024 Law360 Advisory Board for Illinois. He holds active memberships in the Lake County Bar Association, the Chicago Bar Association, and the Illinois State Bar Association, where he serves on the Tort Law Committee. Mr. Salvi is a frequent speaker at legal seminars, CLEs, Kellogg’s School of Management’s MBA business law class, and Notre Dame Law School’s “Personal Injury Litigation” class, and has served as a judge for ABA and AAJ trial and moot court competitions. He also serves on the Board of Directors for Legal Aid Chicago, providing free legal services to people living in poverty.

As the firm’s Managing Equity Partner, Mr. Salvi plays a central role in shaping the continued growth, success, and future of Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard. He earned his bachelor’s degree in Business Administration with distinction from the University of Colorado in 2004 and his law degree cum laude from the University of Notre Dame Law School in 2007, where he received an award for excellence in trial advocacy from the International Academy of Trial Lawyers.

Outside the courtroom, Mr. Salvi enjoys spending time with his wife and three children, traveling, attending his children’s sporting events and activities, going to movies, and playing guitar while his children sing along.
